doctrine: TRIAL plays come only from a real engine's Model_P. Market info, splits, and context leans never create a TRIAL play. TRIAL is not OFFICIAL and carries no confidence.
freeze_record: The git commit that adds this file is the freeze record. Any edit requires TRIAL_POLICY_V2 and restarts every evidence clock.
edge_definition: Model_P minus two-sided paired no-vig probability at the logged price, same non-push basis.
cap_ranking: Highest edge first; ties broken by market_id ascending.
stage_recompute: Each market's stage is recomputed from its full settled TRIAL ledger before every slate. Failing MICRO conditions returns it to PAPER.
evidence_clock: TRIAL rows count as forward evidence only while model_artifact_sha and this policy's hash are unchanged. Any change starts a new clock.
